title: altingia
intro: Altingia, commonly known as Altingia excelsa or Altingia sepium, is a genus of plants in the family Altingiaceae, native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Altingia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a popular choice for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Altingia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
